design: All source selections, registry labels and semantic state reviews fixed before knowledge ranking. Real data chosen by chronology and observable action before retrieval; one retrospective passage excluded. Coverage maximizes newly covered action IDs greedily, breaks ties by the full retrieval rank, fills by that rank, and returns winners in original order. Measures eligible actions, rankable actions, actions entering review, actions with supported proposals, lost/gained proposals and review workload. Four independent original stories, two linked updates, two other works in local corpus.
